description: Probe-only rejection library for hipkernel:flydsl_sdpa_cdna (the generic MFMA prefill objects of FlyDSL's attention kernel; packs/FlydslSdpaCdnaNative.cpp, FlydslSdpaCdnaCommon.hpp, FlydslSdpaShared.hpp; the 56 gfx950 objects of descriptors/FlyDSL/sdpa_cdna/gfx950/manifest.json): a legal graph the engine ships (BSHD, head size 64, 128 or 256, bf16 or half, a key length that is a multiple of 8, scale 0.0883883, declared alignment 16; the base shape is the `shape` axis, a [dtype, B, Hq, Hkv, Sq, Skv, head size] tuple, and the `odd` axis carries the per-family odd values) with ONE feature per case, named by the `family` axis. Every family is a graph the frontend accepts. `expect` is `declined` where the engine must not take the graph (the kernel has no input for the feature or a stated unsupported configuration, so an accept computes something else) and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take it (then it must be right). The catalog: head size 64, 128 and 256 objects (causal 0 and 1; 256 with waves per EU 1 and kv_align 64 variants beside the kv_align 0 ones), bias1 objects for the same three head sizes, sink1 objects for 64 and 128 only, qkm1 objects that serve any Q/K head size up to 64, 128 or 256 that is a multiple of 8 with V the same, and vd128 qkm1 objects for Q/K up to 256 with V 128 wide; no object has two of bias, sink and qk_mask. The generic family's any_diagonal is 1 and it takes a window. Engine-specific families: attn_mask (a bias in Q's dtype, [1, 1, Sq, Skv], served for the exact head sizes: declined_or_pass), attn_mask_bcast_all (a bias [1, 1, 1, Skv] broadcast over every other axis: declined_or_pass), attn_mask_qkm_head (a bias with head size 8 to 112 that is not one of the exact three: no object has both a bias and a qk_mask, so familyKernelMatches finds none: declined), sink_d256 (a sink at head size 256, which has no sink1 object: declined) and sink_with_bias (a sink and a bias together: no object has both: declined), mla_shipped (head size 192 with V 128, which a vd128 qkm1 object serves: declined_or_pass). head_unshipped draws head sizes 264, 288, 320 and 512 (past the largest bucket, 256). q_pad_edge (Sq = 2**23 - 1: Q and O pass servableStrides, but the last query tile's padding rows reach 2**31 bytes, which reachesWithin32Bits declines for a row-tiled object), grid (batch 2**16 with Hq 2**16: the launch's flattened x grid, batch * query blocks * Hq, is 2**32 and candidateGrid declines past int32) and bias_span (a bias [1, 1, 2**16, 2**15]: one slice of the bias spans 2**32 bytes, servableBias asks it within int32) are the further overflow families, all declined. none: control, a graph the engine takes. odd_sq (seqlen_q 1, 3, 63, 127, 129, 191, 255, 130) and odd_skv (seqlen_kv 1, 3, 31, 33, 63, 100, 129, 255): no length the kernels need is a multiple of anything (kv_align is a knob of the object, and every shipped family has an object with 0), so the engine may take them and then must be right: declined_or_pass. head_not_vector: head size 4, 12, 36, 100, 132 or 260, not a multiple of 8: the rows move as 16-byte vectors and servableStrides declines a head stride that is not a multiple of 8 elements: declined. head_unshipped: a multiple of 8 outside the catalog (the values are in the description of the engine), declined_or_pass because a larger catalog may take it. v_head_larger: V and O wider than Q and K, which flydslSdpaCdnaGraphMatches declines (headDimV > headDim): declined. v_head_narrow_unshipped: V and O a quarter of the Q/K head size, a width no object ships: declined_or_pass. kv_heads_differ: V with another head count than K (both divide Hq, which the frontend allows); servableStrides reads V as [B, Hkv, Skv, Dv] and declines any other head count: declined. gqa_ratio: grouped-query pairs with 6 to 128 query heads per K/V head, served: declined_or_pass. dt_q_other, dt_k_other, dt_v_other, dt_o_other: one of Q, K, V, O in the other 16-bit type (the matcher needs one dtype throughout): declined. dt_o_float: float O: declined. dt_all_float: all four fp32; kernelDataTypeName knows bf16 and f16 only, but a correct engine may add an fp32 kernel: declined_or_pass. attn_mask_float (a float bias: the bias must be in Q's dtype), attn_mask_dtype_other (the other 16-bit type), attn_mask_key_bcast (a bias with a broadcast key axis, [1, 1, Sq, 1]: the key axis is read contiguously and cannot be) and attn_mask_odd_skv (a bias with seqlen_kv 130, not a multiple of 4: the kernels read the bias in runs of 4 keys): declined by servableBias. scale_tensor_device (a device-resident scale tensor: only a pass-by-value scalar can become a kernel argument) and scale_tensor_both (a pass-by-value scale tensor together with attn_scale_value: the value would be ignored): declined. seq_len_q, seq_len_kv, padding (padding_mask with both tensors), dropout_philox (probability 0.1 with seed and offset), dropout_zero (probability 0.0 alone: any dropout field declines), dropout_mask (explicit mask and scale tensors), rng_dump, paged_kv (page tables and max_seq_len_kv, one 64-row block, with the seq_len tensors), block_mask, descale_qkv, fp8_softmax_scales (descale_s, scale_s, scale_o, amax_s, amax_o) and alibi (alibi_mask with a top-left causal right bound): every one a feature the kernels have no input for, declined by flydslSdpaCdnaGraphMatches. stats: an LSE tensor with generate_stats, served: declined_or_pass. stats_no_flag: the tensor without generate_stats, which the matcher accepts (only an explicit false disagrees): declined_or_pass. stats_flag_false: the tensor with generate_stats false, stats_flag_no_tensor: generate_stats true without a tensor, stats_half: an LSE tensor in half, row_stats: stats with max and sum_exp outputs (the split statistics are not served): all declined. stats_unpacked: an LSE with token-major strides [Sq*Hq, 1, Hq, 1] instead of the packed [Hq*Sq, Sq, 1, 1]; the generic kernel writes an LSE with strides of its own (vendored-kernel modification 20), the dual-wave kernel only the packed one (isPackedStats). sink_q_dtype (an attention sink [1, Hq, 1, 1] in the query's dtype, head sizes 64 and 128, no bias): the form servableSinkStride takes, so the engines with a sink1 object may serve it; but the references grade only a FLOAT sink (isSupportedSdpaSink), so an accepted graph has no oracle and the driver records it UNEXERCISED, a violation of any expectation: the pair of matchers is a finding in itself, expected declined_or_pass where a sink1 object ships. sink_float (a FLOAT sink, the one the references take: the matcher needs the query's dtype), sink_shape (a sink of Hq + 1 logits): declined. causal_top_left: top-left causal with seqlen_kv at least seqlen_q, served: declined_or_pass. bottom_right: bottom-right causal with seqlen_kv = seqlen_q + 64: declined_or_pass. top_left_sq_gt_skv: top-left causal with more query rows than keys: maskFor declines an offset past Skv - Sq (the causal objects mask the last KV tile's padding with the same compare): declined. bottom_right_sq_gt_skv: bottom-right causal with more query rows than keys: the offset is negative and maskFor takes it, but the rows above the diagonal see no key, which the references give a zero row and an LSE of -inf and the kernel is not described to define: declined_or_pass, a WRONG here is the finding. window (left_bound 8, right_bound 0, top-left), window_no_right (left_bound 8 alone) and window_right_over (left_bound 8, right_bound 16, bottom-right): a window with no right bound declines in maskFor (only the causal objects mask), and so does a right bound past Skv - Sq - align, which is 0 for bottom-right. scale_neg (attn_scale_value -0.125: the running max is taken on unscaled scores, which orders them as the scaled ones only for a positive scale: isServableScale): declined. scale_big (2**21, above MAX_SOFTMAX_SCALE = 2**20, a bound the engines share so that no family overflows f32 where another does not): declined_or_pass. scale_max (2**20, the bound itself) and scale_tiny (1e-30): declined_or_pass. implementation_composite and implementation_unified (the matcher takes only AUTO, an execution-strategy hint a fused kernel can honour), mma_float and mma_fp8 (mma_core_mode other than UNSET, HALF, BFLOAT16): declined_or_pass. overflow: `ovf` names one 32-bit addressing limit pushed past the bound at enforcement_level buildable (no tensor is allocated, filled or executed); strides are the exact dense BSHD strides of the huge dims. expect is declined: kv_seq (Skv = 2**23 at head size 128: K and V of one (batch, head) slice span 2**31 bytes, servableStrides asks them within int32), q_seq (Sq = 2**24: the same for Q and O) and q_seq_u32 (Sq = 2**32), kv_int64 (Skv = 2**40), q_row_stride (Hq = 2**24: the sequence stride Hq * Dq = 2**31 does not fit the int32 stride limit), q_pad_edge, grid and bias_span as above; An accepted and built overflow case is reported UNEXERCISED with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`. No family needs a device to be written down, but none had been run on one when this was written: every expectation is what flydslSdpaCdnaGraphMatches (the graph matcher shared by the three CDNA engines) and familyKernelMatches (the kernel matcher, with the family's constants) say, against the shipped gfx950 manifest. The space is probe-only and never frozen into a bundle.

derive.skv_e: ovf[5] if ov else (130 if family == 'attn_mask_odd_skv' else (64 if family == 'paged_kv' else (max(skv0, sq0) if family in ['causal_top_left', 'window', 'window_no_right', 'window_right_over'] else (max(sq0 // 2, 1) if family in ['top_left_sq_gt_skv', 'bottom_right_sq_gt_skv'] else (sq0 + 64 if family == 'bottom_right' else (skv0))))))
derive.dqk: ovf[6] if ov else (odd[2] if family == 'head_not_vector' else (odd[3] if family == 'head_unshipped' else (odd[5] if family == 'attn_mask_qkm_head' else (256 if family == 'sink_d256' else (192 if family == 'mla_shipped' else (shape[6]))))))
derive.dv: 2 * dqk if family == 'v_head_larger' else (dqk // 4 if family == 'v_head_narrow_unshipped' else (128 if family == 'mla_shipped' else (dqk)))
derive.hv: (1 if hkv == hq else hq) if family == 'kv_heads_differ' else hkv
derive.dtq: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_q_other' else dtype)
derive.dtk: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_k_other' else dtype)
derive.dtv: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_v_other' else dtype)
derive.dto: 'float' if family in ['dt_all_float', 'dt_o_float'] else (other if family == 'dt_o_other' else dtype)
derive.dtb: 'float' if family == 'attn_mask_float' else (other if family == 'attn_mask_dtype_other' else dtype)
derive.scale_value: None if family == 'scale_tensor_device' else (-0.125 if family == 'scale_neg' else (2097152.0 if family == 'scale_big' else (1048576.0 if family == 'scale_max' else (1e-30 if family == 'scale_tiny' else 0.0883883461356163))))
derive.right: 0 if family in ['causal_top_left', 'bottom_right', 'top_left_sq_gt_skv', 'bottom_right_sq_gt_skv', 'window', 'alibi'] else (16 if family == 'window_right_over' else None)
derive.dims_bias: [1, 1, sq_e, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_key_bcast' else ([1, 1, 1, skv_e] if family == 'attn_mask_bcast_all' else [1, 1, sq_e, skv_e])
derive.stride_bias: [sq_e, sq_e, 1, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_key_bcast' else ([skv_e, skv_e, skv_e, 1] if family == 'attn_mask_bcast_all' else [sq_e*skv_e, sq_e*skv_e, skv_e, 1])
derive.stride_stats: [sq_e * hq, 1, hq, 1] if family == 'stats_unpacked' else [hq * sq_e, sq_e, 1, 1]

constraints.rule: family not in ['sink_q_dtype', 'sink_float', 'sink_shape', 'sink_with_bias'] or shape[6] in [64, 128]
constraints.reason: the shipped sink1 objects are the head sizes 64 and 128; a sink family draws only those shapes, so the one reason a case differs from a served graph is the sink itself (sink_d256 is the family for the other head size)

constraints.rule: family not in ['top_left_sq_gt_skv', 'bottom_right_sq_gt_skv'] or sq_e > skv_e
constraints.reason: these families need more query rows than keys, which a base shape with seqlen_q of 1 cannot give (a draw there would render the served shape, not the family)

constraints.rule: family not in ['attn_mask', 'attn_mask_float', 'attn_mask_dtype_other', 'attn_mask_key_bcast', 'attn_mask_odd_skv', 'attn_mask_bcast_all', 'sink_with_bias'] or (shape[6] in [64, 128, 256] and shape[5] % 8 == 0)
constraints.reason: a bias family draws only the shapes the bias1 objects serve (exact head size, key length a multiple of 8), so the one reason a case differs from a served graph is the bias feature the family names

constraints.rule: ov or b_e * hq * sq_e * skv_e * dqk <= 2**31
constraints.reason: GPU reference cost ceiling (RFC 0023 section 14), as the other SdpaFwd spaces; the overflow family runs at enforcement_level buildable, where nothing is allocated or executed
